Fig. 1 The effect of microclimate manipulation treatments on
litter moisture-content, microbial activity, and litter decay during the dry season. (a) Nighttime litter moisture (dry-mass
basis), (b) nighttime litter CO$_2$ flux, (c) substrate-induced respiration (SIR), (d) litter mass loss at the end of the dry season
(n = 5). For (a–c), data were averaged over four sampling days
(3 days for Calicotome) in the dry season 2012 (n = 19, except
Calicotome where n = 14). Different letters indicate statistically
significant differences within a litter type (P ≤ 0.05, Tukey–Kramer HSD test). Mean ± SE.
